probes.title: within a day the repeats of one object fold under «Ещё 2 по srv1.larena.cloud»; a press unfolds them and keeps the focus on the button

steps.script: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 80 && !(document.querySelector('#i [data-fold]')); i += 1) await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 100)); return Boolean(document.querySelector('#i [data-fold]')); })()

a port that does not answer: sf-alert «Уведомления не загрузились» and «Повторить»; the retry loads «Новых: 3»
